title: Source Admission and Real Benchmark Corpus V1
purpose: Add a fail-closed, pre-ingestion source admission gate and freeze the first eight-domain benchmark source catalog without storing source bytes in Git.
invariants: Source admission happens before any model/source-content ingestion.
The gate evaluates explicit curated rights/provenance metadata and does not infer legal rights from a hostname.
Permission-required, prohibited, unknown, unresolved-third-party and unsupported-context sources fail before local source bytes are read.
A PASS binds exact local bytes by SHA-256 but never emits their physical host path.
Dynamic sources such as consolidated law require an explicit caller-bound version/date.
No source documents, PDFs, ZIPs, kits or large media payloads are committed to Git by this work package.
The promoted M3.2 factory gate and merged M3.2.5 reliability layer remain byte-unchanged.
The benchmark catalog covers mathematics, physics, computer science, history, law, medicine, literature and management.
OpenStax and NICE remain negative admission controls and cannot reach model ingestion without separate permission.
No benchmark verdict is forced in advance.
requiredEvidence: Exact six-path delta from the M3.2.5 reliability main baseline.
Repository governance PASS and PR scope PASS.
Existing M3.2 and M3.2.5 product oracles remain PASS.
Source catalog validates with exactly the eight required primary domains and at least two blocked negative controls.
Allowed source with missing conditions HOLDs before source bytes are read.
Permission-required negative controls HOLD with no source-byte binding even when a nonexistent file path is supplied.
Conditional BnF/Gallica source is accepted only in the declared internal non-commercial R&D context and with all conditions acknowledged.
Légifrance source cannot PASS without explicit version/date binding.
Unknown rights and unresolved third-party content fail before bytes are read.
Physical file paths never appear in SourceAdmission output.
Dedicated exact-head CI re-runs repository validation, M3.2, M3.2.5 and SourceAdmission product oracles.
adversarialTests: Permission-required source supplied with nonexistent local path.
Allowed source with required attribution condition omitted.
Conditional source requested for commercial-product context.
Dynamic legal source with no version/date.
Duplicate or missing benchmark primary domain.
Host path leakage in emitted evidence.
independentReview: Source rights metadata must be supported by official provenance/rights URLs captured in the catalog.
The gate must be challenged for pre-ingestion ordering: a blocked source must not be read merely to compute a hash.
M3.2.5 promotion remains blocked until real source bytes are retrieved, admitted, used in independent FactoryRuns and aggregated by the existing benchmark gate.
rollback: Remove the additive source-admission module/catalog/tests/workflow/router entry. M3.2 factory, M3.2.5 reliability, learner runtime, canonical contracts and stored data remain unchanged.
